meta.name: add-mattermost
meta.description: Add a self-hosted or cloud Mattermost bot channel through the Chat SDK bridge, reusing a healthy server when available and linking to official server setup guidance when needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Mattermost 机器人接进聊天频道,复用可用服务器并给出搭建指引
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你团队用 Mattermost,想让机器人常驻聊天频道。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team runs Mattermost and wants a bot living in its channels.

howto.what: Claude 会带你接入 Mattermost 频道:先探测或选定服务器、设置 SiteURL,再复制适配器、创建并认证机器人、配置审批回调,最后构建、测试并重启。完成后可收发私信、频道消息、文件和审批卡片。
howto.when: 当你要求把自托管或云端的 Mattermost 机器人频道接入 NanoClaw 时触发;它会先探测是否已有健康服务器,若没有则给出官方部署指引。

say.text: 帮我把 Mattermost 接入 NanoClaw
say.note: 会先探测现有服务器并让你确认选用哪个。

say.text: 使用现有的本地 Mattermost 服务器,继续配置
say.note: 复用探测到的健康服务器。

say.text: 我的 Mattermost 用户名是 alice,把机器人私信对接给我
say.note: 会解析你并打开与机器人的私信。

howto.what_en: Claude adds a Mattermost channel: it finds or picks a server, sets SiteURL, copies the adapter, creates a bot, sets the callback, then builds, tests and restarts. DMs, channels, files and approval cards then work.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a self-hosted or cloud Mattermost bot channel to NanoClaw. It probes for a healthy existing server first; if none is found, it points to official setup guidance.

say_en.note: It probes for a server and asks you to confirm.

say_en.text: Use the existing local Mattermost server and continue
My Mattermost username is alice — connect my DM to the bot
say_en.note: Resolves you and opens the bot DM.
